landing.heading: Kimistariga glaze oo bilaash ah oo loogu talagalay dhoobo-sameeyayaasha.
landing.lead: Faham glaze-yadaada, ha isku darin oo kaliya. Geli hab oo isla markiiba arag UMF-tiisa (unity molecular formula), saamiga silica iyo alumina iyo dheelitirka flux-yadiisa. Hababkaaga, walxahaaga, midabeeyayaashaada, qoraalladaada iyo diiwaanka gubidda ku wada hay hal buug oo gaar ah.
landing.trialEnded: Tijaabadaadu way dhammaatay. Bilow mid cusub, ama samee akoon bilaash ah si aad shaqadaada u haysato.
landing.trialFailed: Tijaabo hadda lama bilaabi karin. Fadlan mar kale isku day.
landing.heroNote: Is-diiwaangelin looma baahna si aad u tijaabiso · Bilaash iyo il furan · Hababkaagu gaar ayay kuu ahaanayaan
landing.heroAlt: Saf xirmooyin cone ah oo la gubay: cone-yada pyrometric ee cad ee xirmo kasta waxay ku foorarsadeen kulaylka kiln-ka.
landing.heroCaption: Xirmooyinka cone-ka gubidda kadib: cone kasta wuu foorarsadaa marka kiln-ku sameeyo shaqo kulayl ku filan.
landing.exampleHeading: Arag oo shaqaynaya: saldhig celadon caadi ah
landing.exampleCaption: “4321” ee Bernard Leach, oo inta badan lagu gubo cone 10, qaybo miisaan ahaan.
landing.exampleNote: Flux-yadu waxay isku geeyaan 1, sidaas darteed laba glaze kasta si cadaalad ah ayaa la isu barbar dhigi karaa. Halkan browser-kaaga ayaa lagu xisaabiyay, isla koodhka xisaabiyuhu isticmaalo.

unity.title: UMF isla markiiba
unity.text: Arag flux-yada, alumina iyo silica unity ahaan, sida khubarada kimistariga glaze-ku u barbar dhigaan hababka, isla marka aad hab geliso.

substitute.title: Sax oo beddel
substitute.text: Walax la joojiyay? Isbarbardhig formula-yada si aad u hesho beddel u dhalaala si la mid ah.

notebook.title: Buugga istuudiyahaaga
notebook.text: Hababka, walxahaaga, midabeeyayaasha, qoraallada iyo diiwaanka gubidda ku wada hay hal meel.

learn.title: Baro intaad socoto
learn.text: Hagayaal luqad fudud ah, laga bilaabo waxa glaze yahay ilaa gubiddiisa si ammaan ah, ayaa ag yaal tirooyinka.

landing.umfRecipe: Habka glaze-ku wuxuu sheegaa inta walax kasta la miisaamayo. UMF-ta, oo sidoo kale loo yaqaan Seger formula, waxay sheegtaa waxa walxahaasi ku noqdaan kiln-ka: inta molecule ee oksaydh kasta jira, oo loo qiyaasay si flux-yadu isugu geeyaan hal.
landing.umfGroups: Flux-yadu waxay glaze-ka ka dhigaan inuu dhalaalo, alumina ayaa adkeysa dhalaalka, silica-na waxay samaysaa dhalada. Isbarbardhigga saddexdaas koox wuxuu sharxaa sababta glaze kale u ifayo kan kalena aan u ifayn (matte), ama sababta mid u qulqulo kan kalena meeshiisa u joogo, wuxuuna muujiyaa sida loo beddelo walax aan hadda la iibin.
landing.readAdvice: Akhri talooyin glaze oo dheeraad ah
landing.closingText: Hadda tijaabi xisaabiyaha, kadib samee akoon si aad u haysato waxaad samaysay.

about.title: Ku saabsan Glazecalc
about.lead: Xisaabiye kimistariga glaze iyo buug bilaash ah oo il furan, oo loogu talagalay dhoobo-sameeyayaasha, farshaxanleyda dhoobada iyo ardayda.
about.what: Glazecalc wuxuu habka glaze-ka, walxaha iyo inta mid walba aad miisaanto, u beddelaa UMF-tiisa: oksaydhyada glaze-ka laga sameeyay marka la gubo, oo loo qiyaasay si flux-yadu isugu geeyaan hal. Taasi waxay hababka ka dhigtaa kuwo la isu barbar dhigi karo, waxay caawisaa sharaxaadda sida glaze u dhaqmo, waxayna caawisaa marka walax la beddelayo.
about.alongside: Xisaabiyaha agtiisa wuxuu hayaa hababkaaga, walxahaaga, midabeeyayaasha iyo walxaha kale ee lagu daro, qoraallada iyo diiwaanka gubidda, bog <advice>talooyin glaze</advice> ah oo wax ku ool ah, iyo <guides>hagayaal</guides> loogu talagalay dhoobo-sameeyayaasha cusub, laga bilaabo waxa glaze yahay ilaa gubiddiisa si ammaan ah.
about.numbers: Walax kasta waxaa lagu sharraxaa formula-deeda kimistariga ama falanqaynta oksaydhka, iyo LOI-geeda (loss on ignition): qaybta ku gubata kiln-ka, sida carbon dioxide-ka ku jira whiting ama biyaha ku jira kaolin. Glazecalc wuxuu qadar kasta u beddelaa mole-yada oksaydh kasta isagoo isticmaalaya molar mass-yada caadiga ah, wuxuu isku daraa habka oo dhan, wuxuuna u qaybiyaa wadarta mole-yada flux-ka. Midabeeyayaasha iyo walxaha kale ee lagu daro waxaa lagu taxaa habka laakiin kama mid aha UMF-ta, sida caadiga ah.
about.guide: Natiijooyinku waa hage, ma aha dammaanad. Walxaha dhabta ah way kala duwan yihiin alaab-qeybiye ilaa alaab-qeybiye iyo batch ilaa batch, gubiddana waxay muhiim u tahay sida kimistariga, sidaas darteed tijaabi glaze kasta. Glaze-yada dusha cuntada waxaa haboon in loo tijaabiyo biraha ka soo baxa (leaching).
about.built: Glazecalc wuxuu bilaabmay 2017 waxaana dib loo dhisay 2026. Waa hal app internet oo yar, <source>koodhkiisa ishuna wuxuu ku yaal GitHub</source> iyadoo hoos timaada MIT License.
about.stackBrowser: Angular 22 browser-ka (standalone components iyo signals), iyadoo kimistariga glaze-ku ku jiro maktabad yar oo la wadaago.
about.stackServer: API TypeScript ah oo ku shaqeeya Node.js 24 iyo Express 5, iyo MongoDB 9, oo ay hubiyaan in ka badan 350 tijaabo oo otomaatig ah.
about.stackHosting: Wuxuu ku shaqeeyaa Docker ee Amazon Web Services, gadaal nginx iyo HTTPS ka yimid Let's Encrypt.
about.stackDeploy: Waxaa daabaca GitHub Actions: image-yada waa la dhisaa oo la tijaabiyaa isbeddel kasta, daabacaaduna waxay galaan AWS furayaal kaydsan la'aan.
about.credits: Gobollada shaxda Stull waxay ka yimaadeen akhriska Glazy ee shaxda R. T. Stull ee 1912, oo uu sameeyay Derek Au (Copyright (c) 2017 Derek Au, MIT License). <notices>Ogeysiiska buuxa</notices> wuxuu ku jiraa isha.
about.who: Glazecalc waxaa sameeyay Aaron Filson. Dhibaato ma heshay mise fikrad ayaad haysaa? <issues>Ka fur issue GitHub</issues>.
about.studio: Dhoobada gacmeedka ah ee Aaron Filson waxay ku taal <studio>Updraft Pottery Studio</studio> ee Tacoma, Washington. Eeg shaqada, oo dalbo gabal haddii mid ku soo jiito.
about.languages: Glazecalc wuxuu ku jiraa luqadahan. Link kasta wuxuu boggan ku furayaa luqaddaas.

privacy.title: Xogtaada gaarka ah
privacy.short: Glazecalc wuxuu hayaa waxa uu u baahan yahay si akoonkaaga u shaqeeyo, waxba kama badna. Ma jiraan xayeysiis, falanqayn iyo raadraac. Xogtaada marnaba lama iibiyo, shirkadda kaliya ee maareysaana waa Amazon Web Services, oo martigelisa bogga oo dirta iimayladiisa.
privacy.who: Glazecalc waa mashruuc bilaash ah, il furan, oo aan faa'iido doon ahayn, oo uu maamulo milkiilihiisa, Aaron Filson, Maraykanka. Isagaa go'aamiya waxa ku dhaca xogtaada, sidaas darteed sharciga ilaalinta xogta wuxuu ku yahay “controller”-keeda.
privacy.contact: Si aad wax uga weydiiso xogtaada, ama aad u isticmaasho mid ka mid ah xuquuqdaada, u qor <mail>privacy@glazecalcapp.com</mail>. Waxaad sidoo kale <issues>ka furi kartaa issue GitHub</issues>, laakiin issue-yadu waa kuwo dadweyne: marnaba ha ku qorin cinwaanka iimaylkaaga ama wax shakhsi ah. Inta badan arrimaha xogtaada adiga ayaa samayn kara <account>bogga akoonkaaga</account>.
privacy.storedAccount: Akoonkaaga: cinwaanka iimaylkaaga, iyo furaha sirtaada, oo loo kaydiyay oo kaliya hash hal-dhinac ah (bcrypt), marnaba furaha sirta laftiisa. Dejintaada (sida luqadda, gobolka iyo cabbirrada) iyo liiska walxaha aad haysato ayaa lala hayaa. Akoon wuxuu u baahan yahay cinwaan iimayl, si loo galo oo dib loogu dejiyo furo sir la ilaaway. Markaad akoon samayso, link ayaa loo diraa cinwaanka si loo xaqiijiyo inuu adiga kuu yahay; ilaa markaas, iimayl waxaa loo diraa oo kaliya markaad codsato, sida dib-u-dejinta furaha sirta.
privacy.storedShelf: Liiska ka hor isbeddelkaagii ugu dambeeyay ee walxaha aad haysato: mar kasta oo liiskaasi isbeddelo, bogga internetka, access token ama app ku xiran, liiska sidii uu ahaa wax yar ka hor waxaa lala hayaa akoonkaaga, si isbeddelka mar looga noqdo. Isbeddelka xiga ayaa beddela, ka noqoshada isbeddelkuna way saartaa. Wuxuu ku jiraa Soo deji xogtayda, wuuna baxaa markaad tirtirto akoonkaaga.
privacy.storedPrices: Qiimaha, haddii aad wax siiso: waxa aad ku bixiso walax kasta, kiilo kasta, iyo lacagta ay ku jiraan, si loo helo kharashka batch. Waa xog ganacsi, oo lala hayo akoonkaaga oo u gaar ah: marnaba kama mid aha hab, sidaas darteed waxba oo aad wadaagto ma muujiyaan. Soo deji xogtayda waa ku jiraan, tirtirka akoonkuna wuu tirtiraa. Qiimaha tijaabo waxay u guuraan akoonkaaga iyagoo la socda diiwaanadeeda, walxaha aadan qiimeyn, marka labaduba isku lacag yihiin.
privacy.storedEmailChange: Beddelka iimaylkaaga: taariikhda cinwaankaagu markii ugu dambaysay isbeddelay, si codsi ah in la damiyo galitaanka laba-tallaabo marnaba looga aqbalin cinwaan cusub 30-ka maalmood ee kadib.
privacy.storedSignIn: Galitaanka laba-tallaabo, haddii aad shido: inuu shidan yahay; furaha app-ka xaqiijintu la wadaago Glazecalc, oo sir lagu qariyay; passkey kasta, furihiisa dadweynaha (oo kaligiis wax geli karin) iyo id-ga iyo faahfaahinta qalabkaagu siiyo, magaca aad siisay, iyo goorta la daray iyo goorta markii ugu dambaysay la isticmaalay; koodhadhkaaga soo-celinta, oo kaliya hash hal-dhinac ah oo fure leh, si aan qofna dib u akhrin karin; iyo, haddii qof geliyo furaha sirtaada laakiin uusan dhammaystirin tallaabada labaad, goorta Glazecalc markii ugu dambaysay kuu soo iimayl garay arrintaas (ugu badnaan hal mar maalintii). Inta aad galayso, inta u dhaxaysa furaha sirta iyo tallaabada labaad, server-ku wuxuu hayaa qoraal galitaanka ah 5 daqiiqo, boggana wuxuu xusuustiisa oo kaliya ku hayaa token gaaban: cookie cusub ma jiro, waxba kuma jiraan kaydka browser-kaaga.
privacy.storedSaved: Waxaad kaydiso: hababkaaga, walxahaaga, walxaha lagu daro, qoraallada, diiwaanka gubidda iyo talooyinka, sidaad u qortay. Adiga kaliya ayaa arki kara, ilaa aad hab ku wadaagto link.
privacy.storedTrash: Qashinka iyo noocyadii hore: waxaad ka saarto liis waxay ku sugaan Qashinka, dhammaan, si aad dib ugu celiso; isbeddel kasta oo aad ku kaydiso diiwaan wuxuu hayaa diiwaanka sidiisii wax yar ka hor, si aad uga noqoto isbeddelka.
privacy.storedShares: Hababka aad link ku wadaagto, haddii aad wax wadaagto: habka kee yahay, goorta link-giisa la sameeyay iyo inuu muujinayo qoraallada habka, iyo hash hal-dhinac ah oo link-ga ah (marnaba link-ga laftiisa). Qof kasta oo haysta link-ga wuxuu arki karaa habka sida uu hadda yahay, iyo UMF-tiisa, iyo qoraalladiisa haddii aad dooratay inaad muujiso; marnaba iimaylkaaga, akoonkaaga ama wax qiimo ah. Hababka la wadaagay waxaa laga ilaaliyaa matoorada raadinta, link-guna marnaba ma gaaro diiwaanka server-ka. Si xadgudub loo joojiyo, hababka la wadaagay ee laga furo cinwaan IP kasta waa la tiriyaa, xusuusta, 15 daqiiqo. Tijaabo wax ma wadaagi karto.
privacy.storedTokens: Access token-ada iyo app-yada ku xiran, haddii aad samayso ama oggolaato: mid walba, magaciisa, waxa uu samayn karo, iyo goorta la sameeyay, markii ugu dambaysay la isticmaalay, uu dhacayo iyo laga noqday; access token, sidoo kale hash hal-dhinac ah oo token-ka ah (marnaba token-ka laftiisa) iyo 4-ta xaraf ee ugu dambeeya. Waxa loo hayo app ku xiran waxaa lagu qoray “Ku xirista app AI”, hoos.
privacy.storedActivity: Waxa token-ada iyo app-yadu sameeyeen: sadar diiwaan kasta oo access token ama app ku xiran uu sameeyay, beddelay, u raray Qashinka, dib u celiyay ama ka noqday: goorta, token-ka ama app-ka kee, waxa uu sameeyay iyo cinwaanka diiwaanka, oo la gaabiyay. Marnaba qoraalka qoraal ama wax kale oo diiwaanka ku jira. Isbeddellada aad bogga internetka ku samayso lama taxo. Sadarradan waxaad ku aragtaa bogga App-yada ku xiran, iyo Soo deji xogtayda.
privacy.storedPending: Isbeddellada sugaya oggolaanshahaaga, haddii aad codsato inaad xaqiijiso isbeddellada: marka access token ama app ku xiran uu codsado inuu beddelo diiwaanadaada oo aad dooratay inaad marka hore oggolaato isbeddelladaas, isbeddelku wuu sugaa: waxa uu samayn lahaa (oo ay ku jiri karto qoraalka qoraal ama hab), token-ka ama app-ka codsaday, iyo goorta. Adiga kaliya ayaa oggolaan kara, adigoo galay. Faahfaahintiisa waa la saaraa isla marka aad oggolaato ama diiddo.
privacy.storedLimits: Xadka inta jeer: si loo joojiyo qiyaasidda iyo script-yada aan xakameysnayn, tirinta isku dayada galitaanka, is-diiwaangelinta, codsiyada dib-u-dejinta iyo tijaabooyinka cinwaan IP ama akoon ahaan, access token-ada aan shaqaynayn cinwaan IP ahaan, codsiyada lagu sameeyo access token-ada, akoon ahaan (120 daqiiqadii iyo 5,000 maalintii), isbeddellada lagu sameeyo access token-ada, akoon ahaan (60 daqiiqadii iyo 5,000 maalintii), diiwaanada access token kastaa u raro Qashinka, token ahaan, hababka la wadaagay ee la furo iyo link-yada wadaagga ee waxba furin, cinwaan IP ahaan, iyo codsiyada qalabka kaaliyayaasha AI (MCP): 60 daqiiqadii iyo 2,000 maalintii cinwaan IP ahaan, ama 300 daqiiqadii iyo 20,000 maalintii akoon ahaan marka access token la isticmaalo, iyadoo ugu badnaan 10 beddelaad ama u dhigmid daqiiqadii.
privacy.storedTrial: Tijaabo (“Hadda tijaabi”): iimayl ama furo sir ma jiro, kaliya magac la sameeyay sida “speckled quiet kilns”. Haddii aad akoon ku gasho isla browser-ka inta tijaabadu socoto, waxaad tijaabada ku samaysay waxay u guuraan akoonka.
privacy.storedResets: Link-yada dib-u-dejinta furaha sirta iyo iimaylka: akoonka codsaday, goorta, cinwaanka loo diray link lagu xaqiijiyo cinwaan, iyo faraha-calaamad (fingerprint) link kasta (ma aha link-ga laftiisa).
privacy.storedLogs: Diiwaannada (logs): server-ka internetku wuxuu diiwaan geliyaa codsi kasta: cinwaankaaga IP, waqtiga, bogga la codsaday iyo magaca browser-kaaga. App-ku wuxuu diiwaan geliyaa khaladaadka iyo bogga ay ka dhaceen, marnaba cinwaanka iimaylkaaga.
privacy.storedDeletions: Akoonnada la tirtiray: lambarka id-ga akoonka iyo goorta la tirtiray, waxba kale, si kayd (backup) dib loo soo celiyay uusan akoonka u soo celin.
privacy.storedMail: Dhibaatooyinka iimaylka: haddii iimaylka cinwaankaaga dib u soo laabto ama loo sheego spam, adeegga iimaylka Amazon wuxuu cinwaanka geliyaa liis aan mar kale iimayl loo dirin, wuxuuna milkiilaha u diraa ogeysiis ay ku jirto cinwaanka.
privacy.storedInbound: Iimaylka aad u dirto Glazecalc: iimaylka privacy@glazecalcapp.com iyo cinwaannada kale ee Glazecalc waxaa Amazon u hubisaa spam iyo fayras, waxaa lagu hayaa kayd gaar ah, waxaana loo gudbiyaa sanduuqa milkiilaha (Gmail).
privacy.basisContract: Shaqaysiinta akoonkaaga, haynta waxaad kaydiso, iyo iimayllada ku saabsan akoonkaaga waa adeegga aad codsatay: saldhigga sharcigu waa heshiiska u dhexeeya adiga iyo Glazecalc (GDPR Article 6(1)(b)).
privacy.basisInterests: Bogga oo ammaan ah oo shaqaynaya: diiwaannada, xadka inta jeer ee qof isku dayi karo inuu galo, kaydadka, diiwaanka akoonnada la tirtiray iyo liiska cinwaannada aan iimayl loo dirin. Kuwani waxay ku salaysan yihiin danta sharciga ah ee Glazecalc ee amniga, ka hortagga xadgudubka iyo in aan shaqadaada la lumin (Article 6(1)(f)). Muddo gaaban ayaa la hayaa, waxba kalena looma isticmaalo. Waad diidi kartaa adigoo u qoraya cinwaanka kor ku xusan.
privacy.basisNone: Waxba oo adiga kugu saabsan si otomaatig ah looma go'aamiyo, profiling ma jiro, waxbana looma isticmaalo xayeysiis.
privacy.whereHeading: Halka lagu hayo, iyo cidda maareysa
privacy.hosting: Glazecalc wuxuu ku shaqeeyaa Amazon Web Services (AWS): server-ka (EC2), kaydadka (S3) iyo iimaylka (Simple Email Service), dhammaan Maraykanka, Oregon (us-west-2). AWS xogta wuxuu u maareeyaa oo kaliya Glazecalc dartiis, iyadoo hoos timaada <dpa>shuruudihiisa habaynta xogta</dpa>. Qof kale ma helo.
privacy.transfer: Haddii aad ku nooshahay EU, UK ama Switzerland, xogtaadu waxay aadaysaa Maraykanka. Amazon waxay sheegtaa inay shahaado ku haysato <dpf>EU–US Data Privacy Framework</dpf> iyo ballaarintiisa UK iyo Swiss, shuruudaha AWS-na waxaa ku jira Standard Contractual Clauses ee EU, oo weli khuseyn lahaa haddii Framework-ga, oo hadda maxkamad lagu dacweeyay, la burin lahaa. Milkiilaha iyo AWS labaduba waxay joogaan Maraykanka, sharciga Maraykankuna wuxuu ku waajibin karaa inay xog bixiyaan.
privacy.noThirdParties: Browser-kaagu waxba kama soo raro bogag kale: font-yo, script-yo, sawirro ama falanqayn meel kale ka yimid ma jiraan, dejinta amniga ee bogguna way xannibaan. Link-yada GitHub iyo bogag kale waxaa la raacaa oo kaliya markaad gujiso.
privacy.appsIntro: Waxaad u oggolaan kartaa app AI, sida Claude ama ChatGPT, inuu isticmaalo diiwaanadaada Glazecalc. App-ku wuxuu codsadaa inuu xirmo, adiguna waad gashaa oo haa ku dhahdaa bogga Glazecalc laftiisa. Kadib wuu akhrin karaa diiwaanadaada; wuxuu beddeli karaa oo kaliya haddii aad sidoo kale taas oggolaato. Waxba lama xiro ilaa aad doorato. Mar kasta oo aad app xirto, Glazecalc wuxuu kuu soo iimayl garaa ogeysiis magacaabaya, sheegaya waxa uu samayn karo, oo ku xiraya halka aad ka noqon karto.
privacy.appsStored: Waxa loo hayo app kasta oo ku xiran: magaca app-ku isku bixiyo; app isku magacaaba cinwaan internet, cinwaankaas, oo Glazecalc ka akhriyo faahfaahintiisa; app is diiwaan geliya, oo kaliya wuxuu isku sheego, oo Glazecalc hubin karin; magaca host-ka ee cinwaanka browser-kaaga dib loogu celiyo markaad haa dhahdo kadib; waxa uu samayn karo (akhris, ama akhris iyo beddel); goorta aad xirtay, goorta markii ugu dambaysay la isticmaalay iyo goorta uu dhammaanayo; iyo in laga noqday iyo in kale, iyo sababta. Koodhadhkiisa iyo token-adiisa waxaa loo hayaa oo kaliya hash hal-dhinac ah, marnaba koodhadhka ama token-ada laftooda. Waxa uu sameeyo, beddelo, u raro Qashinka, dib u celiyo ama ka noqdo waxaa lagu qoraa liiska waxa token-ada iyo app-yadu sameeyeen, kor, diiwaan kasta oo uu u raro Qashinkana waxaa lagu calaamadeeyaa xiriirka raray. Inta aad haa dhahayso, server-ku wuxuu hayaa qoraal codsiga app-ka ah iyo, markaad jawaabto, akoonkaaga. Si xadgudub loo joojiyo, codsiyada lagu xirayo app-yada waa la tiriyaa cinwaan IP ahaan, xusuusta server-ka, sida xadka kale.
privacy.appsFetched: Waxa Glazecalc soo qaado: marka app isku magacaaba cinwaan internet uu codsado inuu xirmo, iyo mar kale wakhti ka wakhti inta uu xiran yahay, server-ka Glazecalc wuxuu akhriyaa faahfaahinta app-ka (fayl yar oo leh magaciisa iyo cinwaannadiisa) cinwaankaas, bogga app-ka laftiisa. Codsigaasi wuxuu ka socdaa server-ka Glazecalc ilaa host-ka app-ka, waxbana adiga kaama sido. Faylka waxaa lagu hayaa xusuusta server-ka 1 ilaa 24 saacadood. Marka qof xiro app-ka, nuqul faylka ah ayaa sidoo kale lagu hayaa database-ka Glazecalc, si app-ku u sii shaqeeyo haddii faylka la akhrin waayo muddo; mar kale ayaa la akhriyaa 1 ilaa 24 saacadood kasta. Nuqulku wuxuu hayaa oo kaliya faahfaahinta app-ka, waxba adiga kaa ah, waxaana la tirtiraa marka xiriirkii ugu dambeeyay ee app-ka dhammaado, ugu dambayn marka xiriirkaasi dhici lahaa. Waxba kale lagama soo qaado app, waxbana kama soo baxaan bogagga Glazecalc.
privacy.appsKept: Muddada: xiriir akhris kaliya samayn kara wuxuu dhammaadaa 60 maalmood kadib markii app-ku markii ugu dambaysay cusboonaysiiyay gelitaankiisa, taas oo uu sameeyo inta aad isticmaasho; mid sidoo kale beddeli kara diiwaanadaada wuxuu dhammaadaa 90 maalmood kadib markaad oggolaatay, marnaba lama cusboonaysiiyo. Sida access token, diiwaankiisa waxaa la hayaa 30 maalmood kadib marka xiriirku dhammaado ama dhammaan lahaa, si aad u aragto goorta uu joogsaday. Koodh waxaa la hayaa daqiiqo, access token saacad, refresh token-na inta xiriirku jiro. Ka noqoshada xiriir isla markiiba way tirtirtaa; marka mid dhaco, way joogsadaan oo saacadda gudaheeda ayay baxaan. App is diiwaan geliyay waa la ilaawaa 7 maalmood kadib markii uu is diiwaan geliyay haddii aan qofna xirin, ama 30 maalmood kadib markii ugu dambaysay la isticmaalay. Qoraalka la sameeyo inta aad haa dhahayso wuxuu baxaa 15 daqiiqo kadib. Waxa app-ku sameeyay waxaa la hayaa 90 maalmood. Tirtirka akoonkaaga ayaa dhammaan tirtira.
privacy.appsEnd: Joojintiisa: App-yada ku xiran, bogga akoonkaaga, wuxuu taxaa app kasta iyo waxa uu sameeyay, dib u celiyaa waxa uu u raray Qashinka, wuxuuna ka noqdaa hal app ama dhammaan; app aad ka noqoto isla markiiba wuu joogsadaa. Dib-u-dejinta furaha sirta ama “Meel kasta ka bax” waxay dhammeeyaan xiriir kasta, sida ay sameeyaan access token kasta; beddelka furaha sirtu ma sameeyo. Dib u xirista isla app-ka waxay dhammaysaa xiriirkiisii hore, app-kuna wuu dhammayn karaa kiisa.
privacy.appsTheirs: Waxa app-ku ku sameeyo diiwaanadaada waxay u taal app-ka iyo sameeyihiisa. App-ku waa shirkad kale, oo mas'uul ka ah, iyadoo hoos timaada siyaasaddeeda xogta gaarka ah, waxaad u sheegto iyo waxa Glazecalc u diro codsigaaga; Glazecalc wax go'aan ah kuma laha.
privacy.choiceHeading: Halka akoonkaaga lagu hayo, iyo doorashadaada
privacy.choiceProject: Glazecalc waa mashruuc bilaash ah oo il furan. Akoonnada, iyo wax kasta oo ay hayaan, waxaa lagu hayaa server-yo ku yaal Maraykanka, meel kasta oo aad ku nooshahay, sida kor lagu sharxay.
privacy.choiceNoAccount: Uma baahnid akoon si aad u akhrido hagayaasha, waxaadna tijaabin kartaa xisaabiyaha “Hadda tijaabi”, iimayl ama furo sir la'aan. Tijaabo waxaa lagu hayaa isla server-yada 14 maalmood.
privacy.choiceOwnCopy: Qof kasta wuu shaqaysiin karaa nuqul u gaar ah oo Glazecalc ah, kombuyuutarkiisa ama server-kiisa: koodhku waa bilaash <source>GitHub</source>.
privacy.choiceDecision: In aad halkan akoon ka samayso, adigoo og in lagu hayo Maraykanka, waa go'aankaaga.
privacy.choiceNoWarranty: Glazecalc waxaa la bixiyaa sida uu yahay, dammaanad la'aan. Dayactirayaashiisu ma qaataan mas'uuliyad ama waajibaad go'aankaaga ah inaad akoon samayso, ama halka xogtiisa lagu hayo.
privacy.keptAccount: Akoonkaaga iyo waxaad kaydiso: ilaa aad tirtirto. Akoonnada looma saaro in aan la isticmaalin.
privacy.keptTrash: Qashinka iyo noocyadii hore: diiwaan la saaray 30 maalmood kadib markaad saartay, ama ilaa aad si buuxda u tirtirto ama faaruqiso Qashinka; noocyadii hore 90 maalmood, oo kaliya 20-ka ugu dambeeya ee diiwaan kasta (iyo kii ka horreeyay isbeddellada access token) iyo 20,000-ka ugu dambeeya ee akoonka oo dhan, laakiin marnaba kama dheera diiwaanka: inta uu Qashinka ku jiro noocyadiisu way la baxaan. Labaduba isla markiiba way baxaan markaad tirtirto akoonkaaga.
privacy.keptShares: Link-yada wadaagga: ilaa aad joojiso wadaagga habka, u samayso link cusub, u rarto Qashinka ama tirtirto akoonkaaga. Ka soo celinta habka Qashinka mar kale ma wadaago. Dib-u-dejinta furaha sirta ama meel kasta ka bixistu sidoo kale way joojisaa dhammaan link-yadaada; beddelka furaha sirtu ma sameeyo.
privacy.keptTokens: Access token-ada iyo app-yada ku xiran: mid walba waa la hayaa ilaa uu dhaco kadibna 30 maalmood oo dheeraad ah (access token shakhsi kasta wuxuu dhacaa sannad gudihiis ugu badnaan; inta app ku xiran socdo waxay ku qoran tahay “Ku xirista app AI”), ama ilaa aad tirtirto akoonkaaga. Dib-u-dejinta furaha sirta ama “Meel kasta ka bax” isla markiiba way wada joojiyaan.
privacy.keptActivity: Waxa token-ada iyo app-yadu sameeyeen: 90 maalmood, ama ilaa aad tirtirto akoonkaaga.
privacy.keptPending: Isbeddellada sugaya oggolaanshahaaga: ugu badnaan 30 daqiiqo, kadib waxba lama beddelo waana la saaraa; waxa isbeddel samayn lahaa waa la saaraa isla marka aad oggolaato ama diiddo.
privacy.keptLimits: Xadka inta jeer: tirinta waxaa lagu hayaa xusuusta server-ka oo kaliya, 1 daqiiqo ilaa 24 saacadood, wayna lumaan marka uu dib u bilaabo.
privacy.keptTrial: Tijaabo: 14 maalmood laga bilaabo bilowgeeda, kadib waa la tirtiraa iyo wax kasta oo ku jira, ilaa aad akoon samayso si aad u haysato.
privacy.keptResets: Link-yada dib-u-dejinta furaha sirta iyo iimaylka: link dib-u-dejin wuxuu shaqeeyaa 30 daqiiqo diiwaankiisana waxaa la tirtiraa ku dhawaad saacad kadib; link lagu xaqiijiyo cinwaan wuxuu shaqeeyaa, waana la hayaa, 24 saacadood.
privacy.keptSignIn: Galitaanka laba-tallaabo: app xaqiijin kasta, passkey iyo koox koodhadh soo-celin ah ilaa aad ka saarto, damiso galitaanka laba-tallaabo ama tirtirto akoonkaaga. Galitaan sugaya tallaabadiisa labaad waxaa la tirtiraa 5 daqiiqo kadib, app ama passkey aad bilowday inaad ku darto laakiin aadan dhammaystirin, ugu badnaan 10 kadib.
privacy.keptBackups: Kaydadka (backups): nuqullo sir lagu qariyay oo database-ka ah waxaa la hayaa 30 maalmood, nuqullada diskiga server-kana 7 maalmood. Sidaas darteed akoon la tirtiray wuxuu ka baxaa kayd kasta 30 maalmood gudahood.
privacy.keptDeletions: Diiwaanka akoon la tirtiray: 37 maalmood, wax yar ka dheer kayd kasta.
privacy.keptLogs: Diiwaannada (logs): kuwa server-ka internetka, 14 maalmood. Diiwaannada app-ka iyo database-ka laftooda waxaa xaddida cabbirka (50 MB mid kasta), oo bog deggan ku gaara dhawr maalmood gadaal. Nuqullada diskiga server-ku waxay hayaan diiwaanno ilaa 7 maalmood oo dheeraad ah.
privacy.keptMail: Liiska cinwaannada aan iimayl loo dirin: ilaa milkiiluhu ka saaro cinwaan, taas oo uu sameeyo bil kasta cinwaannada aan hadda akoon u ahayn. Milkiiluhu wuxuu tirtiraa ogeysiisyada soo laabashada 30 maalmood gudahood.
privacy.keptInbound: Iimaylka aad u dirto Glazecalc: 30 maalmood kaydka Amazon, iyo sanduuqa milkiilaha inta ay qaadato in lagu jawaabo. Codsi ku saabsan xogtaada, qoraal gaaban (goorta uu yimid, waxa la weydiiyay iyo waxa la sameeyay) waxaa la hayaa saddex sano.
privacy.rightsIntro: Waad arki kartaa, sixi kartaa, qaadan kartaa oo tirtiri kartaa xogtaada. Inta badan adiga ayaa ku samayn kara <account>bogga akoonkaaga</account>:
privacy.rightsExport: Arag oo qaado: Soo deji xogtayda wuxuu wax kasta ku kaydiyaa hal fayl (JSON), oo ay ku jiraan magacyada iyo taariikhaha hababkaaga galitaanka laba-tallaabo (marnaba furayaashooda ama koodhadhkooda), iyo hababkaaga iyo walxahaaga xaashiyo ahaan (CSV).
privacy.rightsCorrect: Sax: beddel dejintaada iyo diiwaanadaada wakhti kasta. Si aad u beddesho cinwaanka iimaylkaaga, fur link-ga loo diray cinwaanka cusub; cinwaankii hore, haddii la xaqiijiyay, waxaa loo sheegaa isbeddelka, qalab kastana waa laga saaraa.
privacy.rightsDelete: Tirtir: Tirtir akoonkayga wuxuu isla markiiba saaraa akoonkaaga iyo wax kasta oo aad kaydisay, “Tuur tijaabada”-na sidaas oo kale ayay tijaabo ku samaysaa. Nuqullada kaydadka waxay baxaan 30 maalmood gudahood.
privacy.rightsSignOut: Meel kasta ka bax: wuxuu dhammeeyaa fadhiyada akoonkaaga qalab kasta.
privacy.rightsAsk: Wax kasta oo kale, sida codsiga in xogtaada laga hayo isticmaalka inta khalad la saxayo, ama diidmada sida loo isticmaalo, u qor <mail>privacy@glazecalcapp.com</mail>. Waa bilaash, jawaabna waxaad heli doontaa bil gudaheed. Waxaa lagu weydiin doonaa oo kaliya inaad muujiso in akoonku adiga kuu yahay, adigoo galaya ama furaya link loo diray cinwaankiisa, marnaba aqoonsi (ID).
privacy.rightsComplain: Haddii aadan ku qanacsanayn, waxaad u ashtakoon kartaa hay'ad ilaalinta xogta: EU, <edpb>hay'adda waddankaaga</edpb>, UK-na, <ico>Information Commissioner's Office</ico>.
privacy.storageIntro: Glazecalc wuxuu dejiyaa laba cookie, tan labaad oo kaliya inta aad ku galayso Google, GitHub ama Microsoft. Browser-kaaga wuxuu sidoo kale ku hayaa dhawr qiime oo yaryar, qoraalka app-ka si loogu isticmaalo internet la'aan, iyo, kaliya haddii aad shido, nuqul diiwaannadaada ah iyo isbeddellada aad samaysay internet la'aan. Mid walba wuxuu u joogaa wax aad codsatay: inaad ku jirto akoonka, inaad ku gasho Google, GitHub ama Microsoft, xusuusta doorasho aad samaysay, ama isticmaalka app-ka internet la'aan. Midna kuma raadraaco, midna lama wadaago, sidaas darteed sharcigu uma baahna in marka hore la weydiiyo, banner cookie-na ma jiro.
privacy.storageNote: Waxaad tirtiri kartaa mid kasta oo kuwan ka mid ah dejinta browser-kaaga wakhti kasta. Tirtirka akoonkaaga ayaa saara qoraalka galitaanka, dejin kasta oo halkan lagu hayo iyo nuqulka diiwaannadaada.

offlineRecords.purpose: Kaliya haddii aad bogga akoonkaaga ka shido “Diiwaannadayda ku hay qalabkan”: nuqul hababkaaga, alaabtaada, waxyaabaha lagu daro, gubidda, qoraallada, dejinta iyo qiimaha, iyo isbeddellada aad samayso adigoo internet la'aan ah ilaa laga diro, si ay u furmaan oo loo beddeli karo internet la'aan. offlineRecords wuxuu qoraa inaad shiday. Nuqulku wuxuu ku jiraa browser-kan ee qalabkan, weligiisna meelna looma diro. Glazecalc ma sir-qariyo; waxaa ilaaliya oo keliya browser-kaaga, oo kayd goob kasta kala fogeeya, iyo sir-qarinta qalabkaaga, haddii uu leeyahay.
offlineRecords.lasts: Ilaa aad tirtirto ama browser-kaagu saaro. Wuxuu ku sii jiraa qalabkan markaad xidho browser-ka, dib u kiciso qalabka, ka baxdo (haddii aad doorato “Ku hay qalabkan”) ama galitaankaagu dhaco. Waxaad tirtirtaa adigoo dooranaya “Ka tirtir qalabkan” markaad ka baxayso, adigoo damiya “Diiwaannadayda ku hay qalabkan”, ama “Tirtir xogta loo isticmaalo internet la’aan” ee bogga akoonkaaga. Haddii qof kale ku galo browser-kan, ma arki karo. Browser-kaagu wuxuu iskii u saari karaa, tusaale ahaan Safari ka dib 7 maalmood oo aan la isticmaalin. Tirtirka akoonkaaga halkan ayaa sidoo kale tirtira. Nuqul ku jira qalab kale lama saaro markaad akoonkaaga meel kale ka tirtirto, ama meel kale ka baxdo; ku tirtir qalabkaas.

offlineOutbox.purpose: Wuxuu qoraa in isbeddellada aad samaysay adigoo internet la'aan ah ay qalabkan ku sugayaan in loo diro Glazecalc, si app-ku u ogaado inuu raadiyo. Isbeddellada laftoodu waxay ku jiraan isla kaydka xogta IndexedDB ee nuqulka diiwaannadaada, hoos yimaada offlineRecords ee kor ku xusan. Kuma jiraan xog shakhsi ah.
offlineOutbox.lasts: Ilaa isbeddellada la diro ama aad tirtirto (ka bax oo dooro “Ka tirtir qalabkan”, dami “Diiwaannadayda ku hay qalabkan”, ama “Tirtir xogta loo isticmaalo internet la’aan”). Isbeddellada aan weli la dirin waxay ku sii jiraan qalabkan markaad xidho browser-ka, dib u kiciso qalabka ama ka baxdo oo doorato “Ku hay qalabkan”.

offlineFiles.purpose: Qoraalka iyo hagayaasha app-ka ee luqaddaada iyo Ingiriisiga, si bogaggu u furmaan internet la'aan, iyo luqadda la kaydiyay iyo goorta. Xog shakhsi ah ma jirto.
offlineFiles.lasts: Ilaa aad nadiifiso kaydka browser-kaaga. Mar kale ayaa la kaydiyaa maalintii hal mar; faylasha luqad kale waa la saaraa markaad luqadda beddesho.

cookie.purpose: Wuxuu kugu hayaa akoonka. Wuxuu hayaa token-ka galitaankaaga. Script-yada boggu ma akhrin karaan, browser-kaaguna wuxuu u diraa oo kaliya server-ka Glazecalc laftiisa, HTTPS, marnaba codsi ka bilaabma bog kale.
cookie.lasts: Waxaa la dejiyaa markaad gasho, akoon samayso ama tijaabo bilowdo. Ilaa aad xirto browser-kaaga, ama 7 maalmood haddii aad calaamadeyso “Igu hay akoonka qalabkan”; 14 maalmood tijaabo. Ka bixistu way saartaa.

session.purpose: Wuxuu qoraa inaad gashay, akoon ama tijaabo, si app-ku u ogaado inuu server-ka weydiiyo. Ma hayo token ama furo sir.
session.lasts: Ilaa aad ka baxdo ama fadhigu dhammaado.

trial.purpose: Inta tijaabadu socoto, magaceeda iyo taariikhda ay dhammaanayso, si loo muujiyo.
trial.lasts: Ilaa tijaabadu dhammaato, ama la hayo ama la tuuro.

settings.purpose: Dejin aad ku beddeshay browser-kan, si bogga xiga isla markiiba u muujiyo, ka hor inta uusan server-ku jawaabin. theme iyo palette waxay midabeeyaan bogga ka hor inta uusan soo muuqan, language-na wuxuu bogagga ku furaa luqaddaada.
settings.lasts: Ilaa aad beddesho. Waxba iskood looma saaro: haddii aad soo noqoto ka dib ku dhowaad sannad aad maqnayd, ogeysiis ayaa ku siinaya badhan aad ku tirtirto dejimahaaga. Ka bixistu waxay dib u celisaa waxaad dooratay adigoo maqan, haddii ay jiraan, inta kalena way saartaa.

visitor.purpose: Luqadda aad dooratay, ama inaad xirtay ogeysiiska turjumaadda, adigoo maqan, si ay u soo noqoto markaad ka baxdo.
visitor.lasts: Ilaa aad tirtirto kaydka browser-kaaga ama tirtirto akoon browser-kan ku jira. Waxba iskood looma saaro: haddii aad soo noqoto ka dib ku dhowaad sannad aad maqnayd, ogeysiis ayaa ku siinaya badhan aad ku tirtirto dejimahaaga.

region.lasts: Ilaa aad shaandhada dib ugu celiso dhammaan gobollada. Waxba iskood looma saaro: haddii aad soo noqoto ka dib ku dhowaad sannad aad maqnayd, ogeysiis ayaa ku siinaya badhan aad ku tirtirto dejimahaaga.

includeAdditives.purpose: In hababka cusubi ku tiriyaan walxaha lagu daro UMF-ta, sidaad markii ugu dambaysay dooratay.
includeAdditives.lasts: Ilaa aad tirtirto kaydka browser-kaaga. Waxba iskood looma saaro: haddii aad soo noqoto ka dib ku dhowaad sannad aad maqnayd, ogeysiis ayaa ku siinaya badhan aad ku tirtirto dejimahaaga.

print.purpose: Doorashooyinkaagii ugu dambeeyay ee daabacaadda hab: habka oo dhan, batch ama xaashida shaqada, iyo cabbirka batch-ka.
print.lasts: Ilaa aad tirtirto kaydka browser-kaaga. Waxba iskood looma saaro: haddii aad soo noqoto ka dib ku dhowaad sannad aad maqnayd, ogeysiis ayaa ku siinaya badhan aad ku tirtirto dejimahaaga.

recipeLayout.purpose: Qaabka aad markii ugu dambaysay u dooratay foomka habka: caadi, miis shaqo ama tallaabooyin la hagayo.
recipeLayout.lasts: Ilaa aad tirtirto kaydka browser-kaaga. Waxba iskood looma saaro: haddii aad soo noqoto ka dib ku dhowaad sannad aad maqnayd, ogeysiis ayaa ku siinaya badhan aad ku tirtirto dejimahaaga.

settingsDates.purpose: Goorta browser-kan uu ugu dambeysay furay Glazecalc isagoo leh dejimaha kor ku xusan, si marka aad soo noqoto ka dib ku dhowaad sannad aad maqnayd loo muujin karo ogeysiiska kuu soo bandhigaya inaad tirtirto, iyo nooca ogeysiiska turjumaadda ee aad xirtay. Xog shakhsi ah ma jirto.
settingsDates.lasts: Inta mid kasta oo dejimahaas ka mid ah halkan lagu hayo.

token.purpose: Token galitaan oo ka yimid nooc hore oo Glazecalc ah. Hadda marnaba lama qoro.
token.lasts: Waa la saaraa marka bog furmo.

readEnglish.purpose: Inaad dooratay inaad bog la turjumay ku akhrido Ingiriisi, si app-ku u joojiyo inuu kuu raro luqaddaada.

reloadedFor.purpose: Kadib marka nooc cusub oo bogga la sii daayo, bogga dib loo soo raray iyo goorta, si bog dib loogu soo raro ugu badnaan hal mar daqiiqadii.

oauthCookie.purpose: Oo kaliya inta aad ku galayso Google, GitHub ama Microsoft: wuxuu jawaabta bixiyaha ku xiraa browser-kaaga, si aan qof kale u dhammaystirin galitaankaaga ama kuu bilaabin mid. Script-yada boggu ma akhrin karaan.
oauthCookie.lasts: Waxaa la dejiyaa markaad riixdo “Ku sii wad Google”, “Ku sii wad GitHub” ama “Ku gal Microsoft”, ama mid ku xirto bogga akoonkaaga. Waa la saaraa marka galitaanku dhammaado, ama 10 daqiiqo kadib.

privacy.children: Glazecalc waa qalab loogu talagalay dhoobo-sameeyayaasha, looguma talagalin carruurta.
privacy.changes: Haddii ogeysiiskan isbeddelo, taariikhda bogga korkiisa ayaa sidoo kale isbeddesha.
privacy.storedProviders: Google, GitHub ama Microsoft, haddii aad mid ku gasho: id-ga bixiyaha ee adiga (lambar ama koodh aan marnaba isbeddelin; Microsoft, oo la socda id-ga directory-ga akoonkaagu ka tirsan yahay: kan ururkaaga, ama kan Microsoft laftiisa akoonnada shakhsiga ah), goorta aad xirtay iyo goorta markii ugu dambaysay aad ku gashay, iyo in akoonkaagu leeyahay furo sir u gaar ah. Waxba kale lagama hayo bixiyaha: magacaaga, sawirkaaga ama fure kasta oo akoonkaaga halkaas ah. Inta aad galayso, server-ku wuxuu hayaa qoraal galitaanka ah, iyo iimaylka bixiyuhu sheego inuu adiga kuu yahay marka loo baahdo: akoon cusub, halkaas oo uu noqdo iimaylka akoonkaaga (iimayl ka yimid Microsoft si kalsooni ah looma qaato: waxaad ku xaqiijinaysaa link-ga aan kuu soo iimayl garayno, sida markaad is diiwaan geliso), ama, marka akoon Glazecalc horay u leeyahay iimaylkaas, si Google ama GitHub loogu xiro markaad akoonkaas gasho (Microsoft waxaa laga xiraa oo kaliya bogga akoonka). Qoraalka, iyo iimaylka ku jira, waxaa la tirtiraa ku dhawaad 10 daqiiqo gudahood.
privacy.providers: Ku galista Google, GitHub ama Microsoft waa doorashadaada, waxayna dhacdaa oo kaliya markaad riixdo badhankeeda. Browser-kaagu markaas wuxuu aadaa bixiyahaas, kaas oo Glazecalc u diraya id-giisa adiga iyo iimaylkaaga. Mid walba waa shirkad gaar ah, oo mas'uul ka ah waxaad la wadaagto, iyadoo hoos timaada siyaasaddeeda xogta gaarka ah. Script ama sawir midkood ah kama soo baxo bogagga Glazecalc.
privacy.keptProviders: Google, GitHub ama Microsoft: xiriir kasta ilaa aad ka furto ama tirtirto akoonkaaga. Galitaan socda waxaa la tirtiraa 10 daqiiqo kadib.

terms.title: Shuruudaha isticmaalka
terms.short: Glazecalc waa bilaash in la isticmaalo. U isticmaal glaze-yadaada, diiwaanadaada iyo waxbarashadaada, cadaalad u noqo server-ka qof walba la wadaago, hana isku dayin inaad jabiso.
terms.who: Glazecalc waa mashruuc bilaash ah, il furan, oo aan faa'iido doon ahayn, oo uu maamulo milkiilihiisa, Aaron Filson, Maraykanka. Shuruudahani waxay khuseeyaan isticmaalka bogga glazecalcapp.com. Markaad isticmaasho, waad oggolaanaysaa; haddii aadan oggolayn, fadlan ha isticmaalin.
terms.code: <source>Koodhka isha</source> ee Glazecalc waa bilaash iyadoo hoos timaada MIT License, oo u oggolaanaysa qof kasta inuu isticmaalo, koobiyeeyo, beddelo oo wadaago, oo shaqaysiiyo nuqul u gaar ah. Liisankaasi wuxuu u yahay koodhka. Shuruudahani waxay u yihiin boggan: server-kiisa, iyo akoonka aad ku samayso.
terms.useOwn: U isticmaal inaad xisaabiso glaze-yo, hayso diiwaanadaada oo wax barato, hiwaayad ahaan, waxbarid ama ganacsi.
terms.useAccount: Hal qof hal akoon, iyo cinwaan iimayl oo adiga kuu gaar ah. Furaha sirtaada, hababka aad u gasho iyo access token-adaada adiga u hay: adigaa mas'uul ka ah waxa lagu sameeyo.
terms.useApps: Ku xirista app AI ama app kale akoonkaaga waa doorashadaada. App aad oggolaato wuxuu kuu shaqeeyaa: adigaa mas'uul ka ah waxa uu ku sameeyo akoonkaaga, sida access token-adaada. Waxaad joojin kartaa gelitaankiisa wakhti kasta bogga akoonkaaga.
terms.useContent: Kaydi oo wadaag oo kaliya waxaad xaq u leedahay. Hab aad link ku wadaagto waxaa akhrin kara qof kasta oo haysta link-ga.
terms.useLaw: Glazecalc u isticmaal si sharci ah.
terms.yours: Waxaad kaydiso adigaa iska leh. Waxaad u oggolaanaysaa Glazecalc inuu hayo, oo u muujiyo dadka aad la wadaagto, oo kaliya si bogga loo shaqeeyo.
terms.leave: Waxaad joojin kartaa isticmaalka Glazecalc wakhti kasta. Tirtir akoonkayga, bogga akoonkaaga, wuxuu saaraa akoonkaaga iyo wax kasta oo ku jira.
terms.fairIntro: Glazecalc wuxuu ku shaqeeyaa hal server oo yar oo qof walba la wadaago. Markaad isticmaasho, waxaad oggolaanaysaa inaadan:
terms.fairAttack: isku dayin inaad gasho server-ka, bogga ama akoonnada dadka kale, ama aad dhigto. Haddii aad hesho dhibaato amni, fadlan u soo sheeg sida <security>siyaasadda amnigu</security> codsato, hana ku tijaabin xogta dadka kale.
terms.fairLoad: u dirin codsiyo ka badan inta uu qaadi karo, ama ka gudbin xadka inta jeer ee wax la samayn karo. Xadkaasi wuxuu bogga u shaqeeyaa qof walba, wayna isbeddeli karaan.
terms.fairScrape: koobiyeyn bogga oo dhan crawler ama script. Wax kasta oo laga dhisay, koodhkiisa iyo xogtiisa, horay ayay ugu jiraan <source>GitHub</source>.
terms.fairAccounts: samayn akoonno ama tijaabooyin dheeraad ah si aad uga gudubto xad, ama isticmaalin akoonka qof kale.
terms.fairMail: u isticmaalin is-diiwaangelinta, dib-u-dejinta furaha sirta ama link-yada wadaagga inaad dadka u dirto iimayl ama link-yo aysan codsan.
terms.fairHarm: kaydin ama wadaagin wax sharci darro ah ama waxyeello leh, ama wax aan adiga kuu ahayn inaad wadaagto.
terms.fairScripts: Script-yada iyo kaaliyayaasha AI waa soo dhowaadaan shuruudahan gudahood. Sii access token adiga kuu gaar ah, si waxa ay sameeyaan loogu tiriyo adiga.
terms.stop: Si bogga loo shaqeeyo, Glazecalc wuu gaabin karaa ama diidi karaa codsiyada, joojin karaa link la wadaagay, ama xiri karaa akoon jebiya shuruudahan ama bogga khatar geliya. Xiritaanka akoon waa tirtirkiisa. Halka ay macquul tahay, milkiiluhu marka hore ayuu kuu soo iimayl garayn doonaa oo ku siin doonaa wakhti aad ku soo dejiso xogtaada.
terms.available: Glazecalc waa bilaash wuxuuna ku shaqeeyaa miisaaniyad yar. Wuu dhici karaa mararka qaar, dayactir ama shil dartiis, astaamihiisu way isbeddeli karaan, maalin uun boggu wuu xirmi karaa. Haddii uu xirmo, milkiiluhu wuxuu qorsheynayaa inuu marka hore iimayl u diro haystayaasha akoonnada oo u daayo wakhti ay ku soo dejiyaan diiwaanadooda. Caawimaad waxaa la bixiyaa marka milkiiluhu awoodo, ma aha jadwal. Hayso nuqullo wax kasta oo muhiim ah: Soo deji xogtayda, bogga akoonkaaga, wuxuu ku siinayaa wax kasta oo aad kaydisay.
terms.warranty: Glazecalc waxaa la bixiyaa sida uu yahay, dammaanad nooc kasta ah la'aan. Inta sharcigu oggol yahay, dayactirayaashiisu mas'uul kama aha khasaare ama waxyeello kasta oo ka timaada isticmaalka bogga ama ku tiirsanaanta. Waxba shuruudahan kuma jiraan oo kaa qaadaya xuquuq sharci kuu leedahay halka aad ku nooshahay.
terms.privacy: <privacy>Ogeysiiska xogta gaarka ah</privacy> wuxuu sheegaa waxa Glazecalc kaa hayo, sababta, iyo muddada.
terms.changes: Haddii shuruudahani isbeddelaan, taariikhda bogga korkiisa ayaa sidoo kale isbeddesha. Isbeddel muhiim u ah haystayaasha akoonnada, milkiiluhu wuxuu isku dayi doonaa inuu iimayl u diro ka hor inta uusan dhaqan gelin.
terms.contact: Su'aalaha ku saabsan shuruudahan: <hello>hello@glazecalcapp.com</hello>. Si aad u soo sheegto xadgudub bogga: <abuse>abuse@glazecalcapp.com</abuse>. Dhibaatooyinka amniga, eeg <security>siyaasadda amniga</security>.

assistants.title: Glazecalc ka isticmaal kaaliyahaaga AI
assistants.lead: Kaaliyayaasha AI sida Claude, GitHub Copilot, Cursor iyo Gemini waxay si toos ah u isticmaali karaan xisaabinta Glazecalc, iyagoo isticmaalaya Model Context Protocol (MCP).
assistants.what: Akoon la'aan, kaaliye wuxuu ka raadin karaa walxaha maktabadda, xisaabin karaa UMF-ta hab, ku hubin karaa xadka gubiddiisa, soo jeedin karaa beddelaad walxaha la joojiyay, dib u samayn karaa hab walxaha aad magacawdo, kala beddeli karaa cone-yada iyo heerkulka, oo raadin karaa oo akhrin karaa hagayaasha. Waxba oo uu diro lama kaydiyo; sida bog kasta, diiwaanka server-ka internetku wuxuu diiwaan geliyaa codsi kasta cinwaankiisa IP, waqtiga iyo cinwaanka (marnaba waxa la diray), 14 maalmood.
assistants.solve: Wuxuu sidoo kale samayn karaa hab u dhigma UMF ama falanqayn oksaydh aad siiso, walxaha aad magacawdo, oo sheegi karaa inta uu u dhowaado, oksaydh oksaydh. Akoonkaaga oo ku xiran, wuxuu isticmaali karaa walxaha aad haysato.
assistants.mine: Access token ka yimid <account>bogga akoonkaaga</account>, wuxuu sidoo kale akhrin karaa hababkaaga, walxahaaga, buuggaaga, diiwaanka gubidda iyo walxaha aad haysato. Token loo sameeyay akhris oo kaliya marnaba waxba ma beddelo, mana saaro.
assistants.caution: Hubinta xadku waa digniino ka yimid xadad la daabacay, sida app-ka, ma aha caddayn in glaze ammaan u yahay cuntada. Tijaabi-gub glaze kasta, oo glaze-yada dusha cuntada u tijaabi biraha ka soo baxa (leaching).
assistants.write: Token loo sameeyay “Akhri oo beddel” wuxuu sidoo kale u oggolaanayaa kaaliyahaaga inuu kaydiyo hab uu kula xisaabiyay, iyadoo Glazecalc xisaabinayo UMF-tiisa, beddelo mid ka mid ah hababkaaga ama walxahaaga, ku daro buuggaaga, u calaamadeeyo walxo inaad haysato, oo diiwaan u raro Qashinka. Marnaba si buuxda waxba uma tirtiro: wax kasta oo uu u raro Qashinka dib ayaa loo celin karaa 30 maalmood, isbeddel kastana wuxuu hayaa diiwaanka sidiisii hore, si aad bogga internetka uga noqoto. Waxa token kastaa sameeyay waa laguu hayaa, bogga App-yada ku xiran iyo Soo deji xogtayda.
assistants.writeSafely: Samee token beddeli kara diiwaanadaada oo kaliya kaaliye ama script aad aaminsan tahay, oo weydii inuu sheego waxa uu beddelayo ka hor inta uusan samayn. Sii wakhtiga ugu gaaban ee ku filan (token noocaas ah wuxuu socdaa ugu badnaan 90 maalmood), hayso token akhris kaliya ah wax kasta oo kale, oo ka noqo marka shaqada la dhammeeyo. Marka hore xogtaada ka soo deji bogga akoonkaaga haddii aad rabto nuqul sida ay hadda tahay.
assistants.connectIntro: Waxaa jira laba hab oo kaaliye loogu oggolaado inuu gaaro diiwaanadaada. Labaduba waxay ku bilowdaan akhris oo kaliya.
assistants.connectSignIn: Ka gal app-ka. Claude, ChatGPT iyo app-yo kale oo badan waxay ku xirmaan iyagoo kuu diraya Glazecalc. Gal, Glazecalc-na wuxuu ku tusayaa app-ka codsanaya, cinwaankiisa iyo halka jawaabtaadu aado, iyo digniin marka jawaabtu aado kombuyuutarkaaga. App-ku wuu akhrin karaa diiwaanadaada; wuxuu beddeli karaa oo kaliya haddii aad sidoo kale calaamadeyso “Sidoo kale u oggolow inuu beddelo diiwaanadayda”. Kadib dooro Oggolow ama Ha oggolaan.
assistants.connectToken: Access token. Kaaliye ama script dira header (Claude Code, VS Code, Cursor, Gemini CLI), samee token bogga akoonkaaga oo geli dejinta hoose.
assistants.connectSee: App kasta iyo token kasta oo aad xirto waxaa lagu taxaa <apps>App-yada ku xiran</apps>, iyo waxa uu sameeyay, waxaadna halkaas kaga noqon kartaa mid kasta wakhti kasta. App cusub kasta oo aad xirto wuxuu sidoo kale kuu soo diraa iimayl.
assistants.address: Sii kaaliyahaaga cinwaankan, adigoo isticmaalaya transport-ka Streamable HTTP:
assistants.token: Si aad ugu oggolaato inuu akhriyo diiwaanadaada, samee token <account>bogga akoonkaaga</account> oo koobiyee. Kaaliyahaagu wuxuu ku diraa header Authorization ah, sida Bearer oo token-ku ku xigo. Ka ilaali faylasha aad wadaagto ama commit garayso, sida furo sir.
assistants.claudeCodeToken: Access token, si uu sidoo kale u akhriyo diiwaanadaada:
assistants.vscode: Gudaha .vscode/mcp.json ee gal, ama dejinta isticmaalahaaga. VS Code wuxuu token-ka weydiiyaa hal mar oo qariyaa; ka saar headers iyo inputs si aad u isticmaasho oo kaliya qalabka aan akoon u baahnayn:
assistants.cursor: Gudaha ~/.cursor/mcp.json, ama .cursor/mcp.json ee mashruuc. Ka saar headers si aad u isticmaasho oo kaliya qalabka aan akoon u baahnayn:
assistants.gemini: Gudaha ~/.gemini/settings.json. Ka saar headers si aad u isticmaasho oo kaliya qalabka aan akoon u baahnayn:
assistants.copyByHand: Laguuma koobiyeyn karin. Waa la doortay: ka koobiyee sanduuqa.
assistants.apps: Ku dar custom connector cinwaanka kor ku xusan. Marka app-ku weydiiyo, gal Glazecalc oo dooro waxa uu samayn karo, sida kor lagu sharxay.
assistants.dictation: Ku rakib skill-ka qoraallada istuudiyaha Glazecalc app-kaaga AI, kadib hadal ama qor intaad shaqaynayso. Wuxuu waxaad sheegto u beddelaa habab, diiwaanka gubidda, natiijooyinka test tile iyo qoraallo, mid walba dib ayuu kuugu akhriyaa, wuxuuna ku kaydiyaa akoonkaaga oo kaliya markaad haa dhahdo. Codku waa kan app-kaaga: Glazecalc marnaba ma maqlo.
assistants.dictationNeeds: Wuxuu u baahan yahay Glazecalc oo ku xiran iyadoo la calaamadeeyay “Sidoo kale u oggolow inuu beddelo diiwaanadayda”, ama token “Akhri oo beddel” samayn kara. Haddii aad App-yada ku xiran ku dooratay inaad oggolaato isbeddellada, kaydin kasta halkaas ayay sidoo kale ku sugaysaa oggolaanshahaaga.
assistants.dictationClaude: Claude (web iyo desktop): dejinta ka shid code execution, kadib Customize, Skills, dooro +, Create skill, Upload a skill, oo dooro ZIP-ka. Sidoo kale Glazecalc ugu dar connector ahaan.
assistants.dictationClaudeCode: Claude Code: ku fur ~/.claude/skills/, oo ku dar Glazecalc sida kor lagu muujiyay.
assistants.dictationChatGpt: ChatGPT, halka qorshahaagu bixiyo skills: soo geli ZIP-ka skill ahaan, oo Glazecalc ugu dar app ahaan.
assistants.dictationPrompt: Kaaliyayaasha kale, dooro prompt-ka Glazecalc “Dictate studio notes”: wuxuu sidaa isla tilmaamaha.
assistants.stop: Ka noqo token <account>bogga akoonkaaga</account> wakhti kasta. Token kasta wuu joogsadaa maalinta aad dooratay, dhammaantoodna isla markiiba way joogsadaan haddii aad dib u dejiso furaha sirta ama meel kasta ka baxdo.
assistants.limits: Cinwaan kasta wuxuu samayn karaa 60 codsi daqiiqadii iyo 2,000 maalintii; akoon token isticmaala, 300 daqiiqadii iyo 20,000 maalintii. Beddelaadda iyo u dhigmidda waxaa lagu xaddiday 10 daqiiqadii. Isbeddellada lagu sameeyo token-ada waxaa lagu xaddiday 60 daqiiqadii iyo 5,000 maalintii akoon kasta, token kastana wuxuu u rari karaa 100 diiwaan saacaddii Qashinka.
